Follows the odd gloss faithfully, pitching the disposition at tension and annoyance rather than graver harm.

Makes deliberateness the charge, which is the one thing the gloss specifies.
Covers the gloss's full span from nasty to malicious, contrasts with malice inside the word, and the example fits.
Names all three gloss components and the register label is a dictionary-type usage fact.
